requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Sales manager creates an order with a valid line quantity
preconditions: The account is authenticated for the order creation API.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made in the sales_manager role.

steps.action: Submit the valid order creation request to POST /api/v1/orders.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 201 and response code CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The valid sales_manager order creation request is accepted with HTTP 201 and code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Order creation accepts the minimum allowed line quantity
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 1.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with line quantity 1.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted and the response has HTTP status 201 with code CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 1 is accepted as the inclusive lower boundary.

test_cases.title: Order creation accepts the maximum allowed line quantity
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 100.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with line quantity 100.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted and the response has HTTP status 201 with code CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 100 is accepted as the inclusive upper boundary.

test_cases.title: Order creation rejects a line quantity below the allowed range
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields except the quantity under test.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 0.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with line quantity 0.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 and QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Order creation rejects a line quantity above the allowed range
preconditions: A sales_manager account is available and authenticated.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields except the quantity under test.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 101.

steps.action: Submit the order creation request with line quantity 101.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 and QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Viewer is forbidden from creating an otherwise-valid order
preconditions: The account is authenticated for the order creation API.
A valid order request can be composed with all required business fields.
test_data: POST /api/v1/orders request with one otherwise-valid order line and quantity 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made in the viewer role.

steps.action: Submit the otherwise-valid order creation request to POST /api/v1/orders.
steps.expected_result: The response has HTTP status 403 and response code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The viewer is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
